mind.body: Boredom can look like a sign that something is wrong. Keep going one more week before you decide.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Already on to the next thing
mind.body: You may notice your mind jumping ahead. Give one hour to what is in front of you.

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Doors left ajar
mind.body: Open options feel like freedom and can keep you stuck. Go easy: close one this month on purpose.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: An itch mistaken for a calling
mind.body: The urge to change everything often passes. Write it down and look again in two weeks.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Covering costs to feel needed
money.body: A 6 month can make paying for others feel like love. Ask whether you were asked and whether you can pay without keeping count.

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Spending more on gifts than planned
money.body: It is easy to buy a little extra for people you care about. Go easy: set the amount first and keep to it.

money.label: AVOID
money.headline: Paying, then keeping score
money.body: Generosity with strings tends to sour. Give only what you can give freely, and say so if you cannot.
money.link: the 6's resentment when care is not returned

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Spending to quiet a guilty feeling
money.body: You may notice a buy that is really about feeling like a good parent or partner. Wait a day and ask who it is for.
money.link: the 6's guilt about not doing enough

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: A flawless budget with no cushion
money.body: A perfect plan can crowd out surprise. Go easy: add a small cushion line and let it be.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Everyone's money, your desk
money.body: A 6 month tends to make you the household treasurer. Hand one money task back to its owner.
money.link: the 6's habit of taking on others' load

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Absorbing a colleague's workload
work.body: You may notice you take on extra because it is quicker than asking. Name what you are carrying and hand something back.
work.link: the 6's habit of taking on others' load

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Fixing what was already good
work.body: A 6 month can send you back to perfect a finished piece. Go easy: write 'good and finished' as the standard.

work.label: AVOID
work.headline: Covering gaps without saying so
work.body: Quiet cover can look like loyalty and tends to teach others to rely on it. Say what you can do in the time you have.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Letting your effort go unseen
work.body: Helpfulness often goes unnoticed. Say what you did in one plain sentence.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: A yes to each small request
work.body: Small favors add up to a second job. Go easy: say 'I can do that next week'.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Fussing over the unasked detail
work.body: Attention to the small thing is a strength and can become meddling. Ask whether it matters to the person it is for.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Suggestions in place of listening
relationships.body: A 6 month tends to turn care into advice. Ask 'advice or just company?' before you offer any.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: A private tally of who gave more
relationships.body: You may notice a quiet count building. Go easy: say what you need in one plain sentence.
relationships.link: the 6's resentment when care is not returned

relationships.label: AVOID
relationships.headline: Solving it before hearing it
relationships.body: Fixing a problem can feel like love and can skip the listening. Ask one more question first.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Adjusting yourself to keep others comfortable
relationships.body: You may find you shape yourself to everyone else's mood. Notice which feelings are yours.
relationships.link: the 6's habit of taking on others' load

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Standing close in case you are needed
relationships.body: It is easy to hover. Go easy: step back for an hour and let them finish.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Hoping to be thanked
relationships.body: Unspoken expectations of thanks can sour a kindness. Give without a ledger, or say what you would like back.
relationships.link: the 6's resentment when care is not returned

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Spent on everyone else
energy.body: A 6 month can make your own needs feel optional. Put one hour a week in the diary for you alone.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: One gathering too many
energy.body: Welcoming people is a gift and can wear you thin. Go easy: choose two you want and decline the rest warmly.
energy.link: the 6's wish to look after everyone

energy.label: AVOID
energy.headline: Doing the whole household alone
energy.body: Quiet effort can look like devotion and tends to exhaust. Name one chore and ask someone to own it.
energy.link: the 6's habit of taking on others' load

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Your rest at the back of the queue
energy.body: You may notice your rest is the first thing to go. Move it to the start of the day.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Everyone fed but you
energy.body: You may notice you reach for comfort food when you have given everything away. Make something comforting for yourself first.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Feeling guilty for stopping
energy.body: Resting can feel like letting people down. Tell someone when you are off duty and keep to it.
energy.link: the 6's guilt about not doing enough

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Measuring against an ideal home
mind.body: A 6 month tends to compare the home and the meal with an ideal. Name one thing that was good enough.

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Guessing everyone's needs
mind.body: It is easy to act before anyone has asked. Go easy: ask once before you arrange it.

mind.label: AVOID
mind.headline: Calling your rest selfish
mind.body: Rest can feel undeserved when others are busy. A rested carer often helps more than a tired one.
mind.link: the 6's guilt about not doing enough

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Carrying someone else's worry
mind.body: You may notice concerns that are not yours. Write them down and ask which you can act on.
mind.link: the 6's habit of taking on others' load

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: A long review of a small slip
mind.body: A 6 month can turn a small mistake into a long review. Go easy: say what you would say to a friend.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Being the one who is needed
mind.body: Being needed can feel like worth. Teach one person to do one of your tasks.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: A week of comparing small options
money.body: A 7 month can turn a modest buy into days of comparison. Give it one evening, then choose the best you found.

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Holding out for every unknown
money.body: You may notice you wait until every unknown is answered, and some cannot be. Go easy: write the three facts you need and decide when you have them.
money.link: the 7's habit of waiting for certainty

money.label: AVOID
money.headline: Hiding the figures from people involved
money.body: Privacy is fine, and secrecy from those affected tends to build distance. Share one plain figure.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Assuming every deal is a trick
money.body: A 7 month can make each offer look like a trap. Check one claim properly and judge from that.

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: More reading, no decision
money.body: Reading more can feel productive and delay a simple choice. Go easy: write the choice and its date.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Big questions crowding out small forms
money.body: Thinking about large things can push aside the small admin. Do one practical task before you read anything.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Solo for weeks
work.body: A 7 month can make solitary focus feel ideal. Share what you have with one person before it feels finished.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Holding work back until perfect
work.body: You may notice you wait to show anything. Go easy: share a rough version and ask one question.

work.label: AVOID
work.headline: Analysis in place of a step
work.body: A thorough study can feel safe and delay a simple action. Write the next step in one sentence and do it.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: A cool reply to someone's excitement
work.body: A dry reaction can read as disapproval. Name one thing you like before the doubts.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Doubts stored in your head
work.body: Quiet concerns tend to grow when unspoken. Go easy: say one doubt in a calm sentence at the next meeting.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: One more fact before deciding
work.body: It is easy to think another fact would settle it. Set a decision date and use what you have.
work.link: the 7's habit of waiting for certainty

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Retreating without a word
relationships.body: You may notice you withdraw and others guess why. Send a short note: 'I need quiet; I plan to reply on Friday.'

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Slow to answer messages
relationships.body: A 7 month can drift from replies and plans. Go easy: answer one waiting message this week.

relationships.label: AVOID
relationships.headline: Keeping your real thoughts back
relationships.body: Privacy is healthy and secrecy from people close to you tends to feel like distance. Tell one friend something you have kept to yourself.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: A wry remark that sounds cold
relationships.body: A dry comment may be read as dismissal. Add a warm sentence after it.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Studying a friend, not hearing them
relationships.body: It is easy to read for meaning. Go easy: repeat what they said and ask if you got it right.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Quiet that nobody understands
relationships.body: Time alone is healthy; unexplained, it can look like rejection. Say when you are recharging and when you are back.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Late loops of thought
energy.body: A 7 month tends to bring mental circling after dark. Write the question on paper and park it until morning.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: More solitude than restores you
energy.body: Solitude helps and, in excess, can drain. Go easy: add one short social plan this week.

energy.label: AVOID
energy.headline: Skipping fresh air and company
energy.body: Staying in with your thoughts can feel peaceful and tends to dull the mood. Take a twenty-minute walk.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: A tired mind and a rested body
energy.body: You may notice your mind tires first. Switch to something with your hands for half an hour.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Passing on the shared break
energy.body: Skipping group breaks can keep your energy and connections low. Go easy: join one a week.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Deep reading past bedtime
energy.body: Absorbing study can cost rest. Set a time to close the book and keep it.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Holding out for a complete answer
mind.body: A 7 month tends to wait for certainty. Write the best answer available and act on it for four weeks.
mind.link: the 7's habit of waiting for certainty

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Skepticism turning sour
mind.body: Doubt is useful and can slide into assuming the worst. Go easy: name one thing that might work before listing what may not.

mind.label: AVOID
mind.headline: Distrusting what is simply good
mind.body: A plain good result can look too easy to trust. Accept it for a day before you look for the catch.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Studying a feeling, not feeling it
mind.body: You may notice you analyze a feeling instead of having it. Name it in one word.

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Running a conversation again
mind.body: Going over what was said can feel like understanding. Go easy: pick one question for next time and drop the rest.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Good ideas kept private
mind.body: Good thinking often stays hidden. Share one idea this month, even half formed.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Worth tied to a figure
money.body: An 8 month can tie self-respect to income or status. Write three things you value that no figure shows.
money.link: the 8's habit of measuring worth by output

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Buying the visible proof
money.body: It is easy to spend on what shows you are doing well. Go easy: wait a week on any buy meant mainly for display.

money.label: AVOID
money.headline: Holding every money decision
money.body: Controlling all the choices can feel like responsibility and tends to shut others out. Hand one shared decision over completely.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: An exact tally of who owes what
money.body: You may notice a precise count of favors and shares. Forgive one small debt out loud.

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Extra hours to reach a number
money.body: Chasing a target can swallow evenings. Go easy: set the hours you give it and let the figure follow.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: A kindness heard as a debt
money.body: An 8 month tends to hear a gift as an obligation. Say 'thank you' and nothing about repaying it.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: A heavier load every week
work.body: Effort comes naturally this month and the load can keep growing. Name one commitment to drop before you add another.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Every detail through your hands
work.body: Control can look like competence and tends to slow a team. Go easy: delegate one task with real authority.

work.label: AVOID
work.headline: Rating colleagues by output
work.body: Measuring people by results can hide what they carry. Ask how someone is before you ask about the work.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: A sharp tone under pressure
work.body: Pressure may sharpen your voice. When you notice it, wait a minute before you send the message.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: A month without a finishing hour
work.body: Without a limit, work tends to expand to fill everything. Go easy: set a stop time for each day.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Owning all the credit or blame
work.body: An 8 month tends to carry the outcome alone. Name two contributors and say what they did.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: People organized like projects
relationships.body: You may notice you manage partners and friends like tasks. Ask what they would like before you propose the plan.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Firmness that reads as hardness
relationships.body: Stress can make you firm and short. Go easy: say 'I am under pressure, not angry at you'.

relationships.label: AVOID
relationships.headline: A running count in a close relationship
relationships.body: Tracking who did more tends to sour affection. Say one thing you appreciate before you raise one that is uneven.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Feelings treated as inefficient
relationships.body: Feelings can look slow to an 8. Listen for two minutes without offering a fix.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Care that arrives only as providing
relationships.body: Providing is real care and can stand in for presence. Go easy: give one hour with no agenda.
relationships.link: the 8's habit of showing care through work

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Setting the pace for others
relationships.body: It is easy to expect everyone to match your speed. Ask what pace feels right to them.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Pushing past your limit
energy.body: An 8 month leans on effort and control. Pick a stop time each day and keep it, even if the list is not done.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Rest as something to earn
energy.body: You may notice rest feels like a reward. Go easy: schedule recovery before the push.
energy.link: the 8's habit of measuring worth by output

energy.label: AVOID
energy.headline: Weekends that turn into work
energy.body: A weekend task can become a habit. Pick one weekend day to keep free of work.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Running on pressure
energy.body: Stress can feel like energy for a while. Notice when it starts to run you and walk for ten minutes.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Skipping the break to save time
energy.body: Skipped breaks tend to slow the afternoon. Go easy: take a real ten-minute break.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Everyone's problems on your plate
energy.body: An 8 month can make you the one who handles everything. Ask one person to take one problem fully.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Grading the month by output
mind.body: You may notice every week gets scored on what it produced. Note one thing that mattered and produced nothing.
mind.link: the 8's habit of measuring worth by output

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: A critic that drives and belittles
mind.body: The voice that pushes you can also put you down. Go easy: speak to yourself as you would to a colleague.

mind.label: AVOID
mind.headline: Wanting control of every result
mind.body: Wanting certainty can feel like diligence and tends to exhaust. Name one thing out of your hands and let it go.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Impatience when others slow down
mind.body: An 8 month tends to speed up as others slow. Ask what the slower pace is protecting.

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Measuring yourself against others
mind.body: It is easy to look at who is ahead. Go easy: compare this month with your own last one.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: A lighter week feeling like failure
mind.body: You may notice a lighter schedule feels like falling behind. Plan one on purpose and see what changes.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Giving past your means
money.body: A 9 month can make generosity feel like duty. Decide a giving amount before you are asked and keep to it.

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Donations spread too thin
money.body: Many small gifts can feel kind and are hard to track. Go easy: choose two causes to support well.

money.label: AVOID
money.headline: Giving until it sours
money.body: Giving beyond your means tends to turn into bitterness. If you notice the sourness, lower the amount and say so.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Skipping a look at your own figures
money.body: Attention to others' needs can crowd out your own. Set aside twenty minutes to read your accounts.
money.link: the 9's detachment from its own needs

money.label: GO EASY ON
money.headline: Keeping something out of loyalty
money.body: You may hold on to items or commitments because ending them feels disloyal. Go easy: close one this month.

money.label: WATCH OUT
money.headline: Unpaid effort and quiet resentment
money.body: A 9 month tends to pull toward unpaid work. Name what you are giving and set a limit aloud.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Saying yes to each worthy project
work.body: A 9 month can draw you into every good cause. Choose one for real time and decline the rest kindly.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: Tending a project past its season
work.body: It is easy to keep tending something that is done. Go easy: write what finished means and close it.

work.label: AVOID
work.headline: Passing every compliment on
work.body: Giving all the credit away can keep your work unseen. Say what you contributed in one plain sentence.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Unthanked effort turning bitter
work.body: You may notice resentment building when work goes unthanked. Ask for what you need before it hardens.

work.label: GO EASY ON
work.headline: A good cause becoming a second job
work.body: Extras can pile up. Go easy: set the hours you offer and write them down.

work.label: WATCH OUT
work.headline: Distance when it gets personal
work.body: A wide view can slip into distance. When someone raises something sensitive, stay and listen for five minutes.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Loyalty past usefulness
relationships.body: A 9 month can keep you in something long after it works. Ask what would keep it alive and what you would need for that.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Giving and not being asked in return
relationships.body: Generosity can hide a wish to be asked how you are. Go easy: state one need to someone close.

relationships.label: AVOID
relationships.headline: Retreating instead of saying it
relationships.body: Detachment can feel like calm and often hides hurt. Say what is bothering you in one honest sentence.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: An old grievance resurfacing
relationships.body: You may notice a past hurt returning. Write the story down, then decide whether you still need it.

relationships.label: GO EASY ON
relationships.headline: Seeing the potential, not the person
relationships.body: It is easy to love what someone could be. Go easy: describe them as they are now.

relationships.label: WATCH OUT
relationships.headline: Rescuing people who did not ask
relationships.body: A 9 month pulls toward helping everyone. Ask 'what would help?' and let them answer.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Giving until empty
energy.body: A 9 month can drain you slowly. Decide in advance what you can offer this week and stop there.

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: A cause that does not switch off
energy.body: Worthy work can take every evening. Go easy: pick one day a week when it is off the table.
energy.link: the 9's habit of living for a cause

energy.label: AVOID
energy.headline: Putting everyone before yourself
energy.body: Putting everyone first can feel noble and tends to wear thin. Do one thing for yourself each day.

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: A heaviness you push past
energy.body: Endings can bring a sadness that is easy to skip. Take ten minutes to sit with it and write one sentence.
energy.link: the 9's detachment from its own feelings

energy.label: GO EASY ON
energy.headline: Play squeezed out
energy.body: A serious month can crowd out play. Go easy: add one small, purely enjoyable thing a week.
energy.link: the 9's habit of living for a cause

energy.label: WATCH OUT
energy.headline: Every closing carried alone
energy.body: A 9 month tends to bring many endings. Mark each with a small ritual, then put it down.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Old hurts on repeat
mind.body: A 9 month can bring old grievances back. When one returns, ask whether it is still useful and write a line to set it down.

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: A wide view with no foothold
mind.body: Seeing everything can make you unsure where to act. Go easy: choose one small thing that is yours to do.

mind.label: AVOID
mind.headline: Believing nobody understands
mind.body: Feeling unseen can slide into bitterness. Tell one person what you wish they knew.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: The cause eating your own plans
mind.body: You may notice your own plans waiting while the cause gets everything. Write one personal goal and give it a date.
mind.link: the 9's habit of living for a cause

mind.label: GO EASY ON
mind.headline: Guilt over what is undone
mind.body: It is easy to feel bad about unfinished things. Go easy: list three, finish one, and release the rest.

mind.label: WATCH OUT
mind.headline: Keeping a distance from people
mind.body: A wide perspective can turn into distance. Share one personal thing with someone this month.
